text:
Priya: FYI launching GH200-optimized Dedicated beta now in us-west2-a and ap-south1-b. Targets customers needing larger KV caches / long contexts.

Priya: Quick bullets:
- Available as Dedicated reserved + burst-attach (no ephemeral shared).
- Per-org default limit: 4 GPUs; burst cap: 1 GPU-equivalent.
- Minimum commit: 7 days for reserved.
- Beta pricing guidance: ~ $0.85/hr per GPU; subject to change.

Liam: Deploy status: canaries passed in us-west2-a. ap-south1-b pending final firmware patch; short maintenance window 03:30-04:30 UTC expected.

capacity-bot: Inventory: us-west2-a: 6 GH200 nodes; ap-south1-b: 3 nodes. Whitelist required.

Sasha: Compliance: Dedicated-only during beta; VPC images coming later. Do not promise Private yet.

Carlos: SRE note: watch OOM/sec and memory-partition utilization. Alert if OOM/sec >0 for >30s. Expected P95 depends on model size (350-600ms).

ops-oncall: Added dashboards and paging rules. I will monitor first 48h.

Priya: CLI example (whitelist only):
``
redwoodctl dedicated reserve --pool gh200-optimized --zone us-west2-a --count 2 --duration 14d --billing-acct ACCT-999
``

Priya: Action items: eng-runtime collect perf telemetry & publish EOD+3; Infra to confirm Private image timeline; CS/Sales to start invites. Internal doc: https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/dedicated/gh200-beta (internal).
